data.explanation: This letter confirms a scheduled appointment to apply for a new passport (Reisepass). Bring your previous ID, a current biometric photo, and €70.00 (card payment accepted) to the appointment. If you cannot attend, cancel it online as instructed. There is no legal deadline attached to this letter — just make sure to show up on time with all required documents, or cancel in advance if you cannot make it.
